Leah Gomez: Quick heads-up: BigBank legal pushed back on our SIG response. They want an explicit risk acceptance for not using customer HSM for inference KV cache and want 12-month log retention under customer CMK.

Arjun Patel: Do they want the KV cache keys in their HSM or just the logs? sometimes customers conflate both.

Leah Gomez: Their note: "All cryptographic keys used for customer data (including ephemeral inference caches) must be customer-controlled in HSM. Logs must be retained 12 months and encrypted with customer KMS."

InfraBot: Auto-response: current infra supports CMK for persisted S3 objects and EBS. KV cache is in-memory and encrypted with platform keys; no persistent storage of raw KV by default.

Samira Khan: For POC we can propose compensating control: no persistent KV writes; ensure cache ephemeral on node restart and add memory-scrub on termination. Offer customer option to disable KV caching entirely for their POC.

Leah Gomez: Sales: customer insists on a formal documented exception or we'll lose the deal. AE says engineering can do POC with controls but legal/security needs to approve.

Arjun Patel: Proposed POC scope to present:
1) KV cache set to disabled or ephemeral-only mode (no writes to disk).
2) Memory-scrub on node shutdown and daily scrub job.
3) Logs forwarded in real-time to customer-owned S3 encrypted with CMK, retention 12 months. Redwood retains no long-term copy; 7-day incident buffer with documented deletion.
4) NDA addendum acknowledging residual debugging copies during incident response.

SalesOpsBot: Note: AE needs signed LOI to start provisioning. They want security OK before LOI.

Leah Gomez: Security next steps: create SEC ticket and schedule emergency review with CISO. We need to confirm if disabling KV cache impacts model latency for the POC  engineering to confirm.

Samira Khan: Engineering ETA: testing latency impact now. If it's within 15% of baseline we can proceed for POC.

Arjun Patel: If CISO approves the compensating controls for POC only, add review milestone at 90 days and limit scope to the POC environment.

Leah Gomez: I'll draft the exception letter for Legal and the customer. Will post draft here when ready.

Samira Khan: Also adding a monitoring rule: alert if any node writes KV to disk accidentally.

Leah Gomez: Thanks team. Posting draft in 30.

Arjun Patel: +1 to conditional approval path.

Leah Gomez: Draft posted: https://redwood.internal/drafts/bigbank-exception-1765089999 — feedback welcome.

Samira Khan: A few minor wording tweaks on scrub frequency. I'll comment on the doc.

Leah Gomez: Updated. Scheduling SEC-4999 for review.

Leah Gomez: Final: Security will provisionally accept compensating controls for POC only, subject to SEC-4999 outcome and latency verification.

Arjun Patel: Marking as approved-for-poc in the tracker pending CISO sign-off.

SalesOpsBot: AE notified. LOI on hold until final sign-off.

Leah Gomez: Great work everyone.
